req.title: Content-Type is JSON
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /players endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that all /players endpoints returning a body must have a Content-Type of application/json. This ensures that clients can correctly parse the response. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to handle incorrect requests, and a boundary test to check edge cases.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_content_type_json
preconditions: The /players/ endpoint is available and returns a body.
actions: Send a GET request to the /players/ endpoint.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/json'

tests.name: test_get_player_by_invalid_id
actions: Send a GET request to the /players/{player_id} endpoint with an invalid UUID.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
invalid_uuid = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'
response = client.get(f'/players/{invalid_uuid}')
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/json'

tests.name: test_get_player_by_squad_number_boundary
actions: Send a GET request to the /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} endpoint with a squad number at the boundary of existing data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
boundary_squad_number = 1  # Assuming 1 is a boundary value
response = client.get(f'/players/squadnumber/{boundary_squad_number}')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/json'
